title: Tanzanian Grilled Chicken
community: Enjoyed nationwide — Tanzania's most popular grilled protein
author: Chef Jabir
desc: Kuku wa Kuchoma — Tanzanian grilled chicken. Chicken pieces marinated in garlic, ginger, lemon, and Tanzanian spices, grilled over charcoal until deeply golden, slightly charred, and irresistibly fragrant. Tanzania's favourite weekend and celebration chicken.
longDesc: Grilled chicken is Tanzania's most beloved affordable protein over charcoal — less expensive than goat but just as satisfying when properly marinated and grilled. At every weekend nyama choma spot across Tanzania, kuku wa kuchoma is the most ordered item.
steps: Score chicken pieces 3—4 times to the bone.
Mix marinade. Rub into scores and all over. Marinate 2 hours.
Grill over medium coals, skin-side down, 10 minutes.
Continue turning every 5 minutes for 25—30 total minutes.
chefTips: Score deeply — the marinade needs to reach the bone.
Medium heat only — chicken burns easily.
Check doneness — no pink at the bone.
cookingScience: Scoring breaks the skin barrier — allowing the oil-based marinade to penetrate the muscle fibres beneath. This produces a more evenly seasoned result than surface marination alone.
culturalNote: Kuku wa Kuchoma is Tanzania's most democratic celebration food — affordable enough for everyday but impressive enough for guests. Every Tanzanian jiko cook has their own marinade that they guard fiercely.
